title: Invitation
subtitle: Pick one of the fixed templates for this event type, set the public slug, and turn on the invitation. Guests will be able to read and RSVP.

templates.title: Template
templates.subtitle: Each event type ships with a curated set. The template fills with the data you capture from the other tabs.
templates.empty: No templates available for this event type yet.

publicLink.title: Public link
publicLink.description: The slug becomes the public URL of the invitation. Lowercase kebab-case only.

settings.title: Invitation settings
settings.activeDescription: Guests can open the link, read all the modules, and RSVP.
settings.inactiveDescription: The page is reachable but shows 'not yet active'. Useful while you prepare the data.
settings.rsvpEnabledDescription: Guests can confirm, decline, or add a message.
settings.deadlineHelper: Optional. The invitation hides the RSVP form after this date.
